dialogues.speaker: Furat
dialogues.text: Hmm... In my opinion, it's half-and-half.

dialogues.speaker: Furat
dialogues.text: If you are good at studying, you don't have to worry about making a living; but if you are too good, I hear there's a risk of going mad?

dialogues.speaker: Furat
dialogues.text: So, it's best for an ordinary person like me to just look for a job that suits me.

dialogues.speaker: Furat
dialogues.text: Oh, right. I forgot to introduce myself. I'm a supplier, and I mainly provide Pardis Dhyai with basic supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Furat
dialogues.text: You can contact me too, if you need any daily necessities.
